generalizations: This is a food-role diagram, not a geographic route map, restaurant ranking, or universal timetable
Gora or the museum, Owakudani, and Lake Ashi are alternative lunch anchors rather than three required meals
Amasake Chaya appears only when the old road or route K belongs to the actual trip
Ryokan dinner appears only for a meal-inclusive booking and its actual time comes from the property confirmation
Every current shop, menu, stock, service, and transport detail requires a release recheck
